summary: Return RFC 9457 404 for unknown user ids and reject blank names on create. Keep the in-memory store.
apiContract: GET /api/v1/users/{id} -> 200 User or 404 application/problem+json. POST /api/v1/users -> 201 User or 400 when name is blank. JSON fields stay lowerCamelCase.
dataModel: User(id, name, email) unchanged. No new tables.
risks: Do not log names or emails.
